set.body: Follow-up from the AC4-S1 cold review (finding 3, and the rule-8 root of finding 1). CaptionSearch.requestDescribes compares only sha, count and geometry, so a request issued for selection A joins sampled frames of selection B with the same declared digest and count. Carry frames.identity, or a selection digest, in CaptionRequest (a worker wire change: caption-request schema v2) and check it at the join. Also make CaptionExtent a final non-case class whose only construction is CaptionExtent.of, which removes the forged-shape door the join now re-checks. Belongs with AC4-S2/S3.
set.title: [media] Caption request binds the frame selection; CaptionExtent becomes unforgeable (rule 8)
